observations.finding: The six-inch travel-kit concession establishes Buddy own departure interest; his leaf-slap experiment punctures Neet prana evangelism. Fetch flips the supposedly sedentary dog into the competent athlete. Nudging the ball against Sagar shoe and ignoring Neet recall make his choices serve play, not generalized obedience. Heather returning the abandoned ball closes the summon joke with a practical answer.

Timed scenes deliberately remain third person. The explicitly titled Final Thought changes to Neet first person, retaining Wind-Lord ceremonial self-regard and the comic claim to let Buddy fetch. This hybrid is legible and must not be normalized into a uniform narrator.

Packing, journey, school play, return, later dinner and nighttime exclusion progress clearly. Later in the 1:23 PM section supplies the dinner time transition and supports the sheera image evening light. Short isolated lines land the athletic reversal, failed recall and Buddy snore without explanatory padding.

Morning shows Buddy beside the reachable zipper after yielding minimal space. Fetch shows the ball still in Buddy mouth before the following paragraph drops it at Sagar feet. Sheera shows Heather seated with plate, Buddy already sitting and Neet bowed before his portion is accepted. None interrupts attribution or contradicts a completed handoff.

Three different contributions read clearly: cramped packing negotiation, outdoor ball-return triumph and indoor treat anticipation. Wide standing profile, approaching action and seated/upward gaze provide varied scale and staging. All pictures loaded completely; no broken image or clipping of source artwork was observed.

Buddy chooses undisturbed rest while Neet theatrical exclusion softens when Sagar acknowledges him. The wave and thumbs up earn comfort without reversing the balcony boundary. The unillustrated final scenes have room to resolve before the first-person closing fetch callback.
